escape_artist.name: Escape Artist
escape_artist.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Use Rope gives +2 on Escape Artist checks when escaping from rope bonds.

actions.name: Wriggle Free from Grapple
actions.description: Make an Escape Artist check in place of an opposed grapple check to break free from a hold or pin.

actions.name: Slip Ropes or Manacles
actions.description: Slip hands or torso out of bindings, manacles, or tight constrictors.

actions.name: Squeeze Through Tight Space
actions.description: Wriggle through a narrow chute or opening where your head fits but your shoulders wouldn't normally.
